method: Imagegen integrado, doce atlas originales basados en las referencias del usuario.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for AKIRA: sprite ATLAS 2 of 12, theme Alegría.
Reference image 1 is the approved newly drawn AKIRA sprite sheet: match EXACTLY this SAME cute white male Samoyed puppy identity, pixel-art rendering, small dot eyes, button nose, soft muzzle, body shape, sitting silhouette and relative proportions. Reference image 2 is his real dog photo; reference image 3 is the original approved mascot. These references define ONE consistent character, not a new dog design.
Draw ONE exact 3 columns by 3 rows sprite sheet, square image. Nine equal square cells with each dog centered. Same alignment, same seated full-body pose, front paws, curled tail beside him, complete ears/feet/tail within central 78% of cell. All cells equal-sized; transparent gutters between cells. No dividers/grid lines. Actual transparent background.
Nine visibly DIFFERENT facial expressions in read order, left to right then top to bottom:
1. bright smile, small open mouth with tiny tongue tip and dot eyes
2. gentle laugh, both eyes softly closed and a wider small mouth
3. amused squint on left eye and relaxed right dot eye, tiny grin
4. playful side smile, leftward dot pupils, one ear relaxed
5. excited rounded small eyes, mouth a short happy crescent
6. satisfied smile with half-closed eyes, ears upright
7. proud quiet smile, chin slightly raised, eyes looking forward
8. shy happy smile, eyes looking down-left, small blush
9. joyful surprised smile with gently lifted ears, mouth open oval
Each must have a different FACE: vary eyes, gaze, small mouth shape and ear posture as described, not color swaps. Keep body identical and male puppy identity stable. Simple classic clean pixel art, warm-white fur, small pink ear centers, very subtle warm-gray shadows, crisp restrained outlines, rounded soft features. Match reference 1 closely.
Absolutely NO teeth/fangs/human lips, giant mouth, angry heavy brows, creepy eyes, scary anatomy, stretched muzzle, facial overlays, gradients or 3D. No collar, ring, harness, bone, hearts, sparkles, props, letters, numbers, words, watermark or background. No clipping. This is a gentle friendly assistant puppy.
